lines:
Execution order: Markdown step 6 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 29 (Markdown 05/12 — Integrate design references, search and scope discovery). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Expose the completed shared domain through the existing grouped MCP surface; extend adashi_design rather than creating a parallel document service.
Scope:
- Add closed upsert_markdown and delete_markdown save variants with the approved canonical fields; extend Markdown code bindings and dependency protection. Use operationId/changeIntent/readTokens exactly like other design artefacts.
- Extend get_overview/get_scope/get_by_ids/get_documents/get_bindings/search and adashi_grep. Explicit reads return complete canonical editable objects and opaque tokens; metadata/search remains bounded and clearly non-editable.
- Extend task/QA target schemas, resolution and help examples for markdown links.
- Update adashi_help operation schema extraction, filtered changeTypes, tools/list publication, examples, error diagnostics and response schemas together. Do not accept historical guards or project revision as document tokens.
- Preserve fresh-token merge guidance, all-or-nothing multi-document saves, idempotency, protected generated artefacts and no-op semantics.
- Ensure postcommit projection status cannot turn a saved mutation into an ambiguous tool failure. MCP reads must not rewrite canonical storage.
Acceptance:
- Real stdio MCP tests on both available backends cover create, full retrieval, edit, body search, project scope, bindings, task/QA references, stale conflict/merge, delete dependencies, replay and malformed payloads.
- Help examples validate against the actual published schemas. Rebuilt MCP clients are reconnected before end-to-end evidence is claimed.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications and linked diagram(s). The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.
